create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting values on Runner or Reducer classes
use_ManagedAttribute_get: use the ManagedAttribute descriptor to retrieve a private attribute value from a Runner or Reducer instance
use_ManagedAttribute_set: use the ManagedAttribute descriptor to set a value on a Runner or Reducer instance with optional type validation
review_ManagedAttribute_set_name: review the ManagedAttribute __set_name__ method that maps public attribute names to private underscore-prefixed names
test_ManagedAttribute_type_enforcement: test the ManagedAttribute descriptor to verify it raises ValueError when an incorrect type is assigned
